concepts.name: Agent harness
concepts.definition: Orchestrates agent, task environment, trial lifecycle, evidence capture and scoring.

concepts.name: Artifact grading boundary
concepts.definition: Defines which outputs cross from the agent environment to a verifier.

concepts.name: Agent bridge
concepts.definition: Adapts agent model/tool traffic into an evaluation runtime; may change effective generation or capability policy.

concepts.name: Trajectory completeness
concepts.definition: Separate property from schema validity: whether relevant calls, results, media and subagents were actually retained.

concepts.name: Runtime budget unit
concepts.definition: The precise operation counted by a limit: generation, primitive action, token, cost or elapsed time.

concepts.name: Remote exec semantics
concepts.definition: Process, output, timeout, cancellation and cleanup contract behind an execution interface.

concepts.name: Checkpoint scope
concepts.definition: The registered state and filesystem subset captured and restored, excluding untracked external side effects.

concepts.name: Evaluation cache identity
concepts.definition: Fields used to identify a reusable prediction or report; omitted content changes require invalidation.

concepts.name: Computer action transport
concepts.definition: Converts agent actions into remote input/program execution and feedback, with endpoint-specific failure semantics.

concepts.name: Original runtime mechanism lab
concepts.definition: Self-written counterexample experiments, distinct from reproducing an upstream benchmark.

evidence.claim: SingleStepTrial runs agent, syncs logs, collects artifacts, and grades; agent timeout/nonzero status is separate from reward and its validity.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: The inspected separate verifier path creates a fresh environment and transfers declared artifacts rather than copying all agent filesystem state.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: Verifier.verify reads validated reward files; the test-script return code is not directly used as the final numeric reward.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: Installed-agent setup includes configuration even when installation is skipped; Codex integration includes effective config, native sessions and post-run log conversion.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: Sandbox bridge defaults forward_generation_config to false and resolves aliases/models before forwarding; its default can alter native generation settings.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: Host tools normally consume a matching model-proposed grant once; proposal exemption is an explicit capability change.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: Read documentation/docstring refers to Stdio configs, while pinned _register_bridged_tools returns MCPServerConfigHTTP.
limitations: Version-specific documentation/implementation mismatch; not exercised at runtime.

evidence.claim: is_root_agent can be true for unknown attribution; positive root attribution requires explicit kind == root.
limitations: Context helper implementation and example task inspected; complete downstream consumers were not traced.

evidence.claim: ATIF trajectory validation checks present observation references but does not require every tool call to have an observation; session_id and trajectory_id have different scopes.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: Inspected Codex converter merges descendant usage into parent final_metrics and propagates unknown values rather than treating them as zero.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: Codex post-run trajectory conversion failure is logged and returns without filling usage; missing telemetry must not be interpreted as zero cost.
limitations: No observed production data loss; code-path analysis only.

evidence.claim: Inspect documents registered agent state, selected sandbox filesystem paths and sample state; arbitrary process RAM, running tools and external side effects are not captured.
limitations: Documentation only; no checkpoint source trace or restore execution.

evidence.claim: Harbor Docker, Modal direct and Daytona POSIX direct adapters differ in stream handling, timeout layers and session cleanup; their shared exec signature does not prove semantic equivalence.
limitations: No provider or SDK-level execution; direct-path findings do not cover DinD.

evidence.claim: SSHAccess manages transport/workspace and a local SSH subprocess; provisioning and isolation remain provider responsibilities.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: mini-SWE-agent batch creates a new agent per instance, saves submission as model_patch, and skips existing prediction keys unless redo is enabled.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: DefaultAgent counts model calls at query boundaries, executes a response action list sequentially, and can cross a cost threshold on the final billed call.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: SWE-bench run_instance reuses an existing report keyed by run/model/instance without comparing the patch in that branch; rewrite_reports reuses existing test output.
limitations: Cache condition inspected; no stale production report or full evaluation run observed.

evidence.claim: The ordinary OSWorld runner increments max_steps per predict round and may execute multiple returned actions within that round.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: The inspected Calc task grades saved sheet_data through file getters and compare_table; this configuration does not establish all formatting/formula properties.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: BrowserGym separates mapped action execution and task.validate; multi-action code executes without intermediate agent feedback and parser strictness is configurable.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: In the inspected ordinary step path, the guest can return HTTP 200 with nonzero command returncode and step does not propagate the controller return dict into agent observation.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: The normal input endpoint distinguishes pre-send failure from uncertain completion and attempts best-effort stranded-input release; script endpoint retry policies differ.
limitations: Source trace only; no upstream end-to-end execution.

evidence.claim: Seven original algorithm counterexamples ran three times each, covering budget units, cost overshoot, trace completeness, inclusive totals, cache keys, external effects and truncation.
